- **Your first pull request here.** GitHub holds each CI run for the maintainer to approve until your first pull request here is merged, so it is normal for checks not to start right away. You don't need to do anything. On a pull request from a fork, the Vercel check fails (Authorization required to deploy.), and a change to `docs/` adds a Mintlify Preview (fork) check that shows as neutral: both are expected, and neither is required. `CI green` is the only check that gates the merge ([what happens after you open it](https://github.com/jannskiee/floe/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#what-happens-after-you-open-it)).
